orb_overlay.filter_rule: Skip the top chop quartile of daily NQ chop scores.

notes.vwap_distance_bps: Signed distance from session VWAP in basis points during RTH.
notes.htf_axes: X is directional efficiency, Y is balance and rotation score, Z is chop score. Higher chop score means more auction balance and less directional persistence.
notes.htf_trend_axes: Trend surfaces keep directional efficiency on X, move trend alignment to Y, and map trend score on Z.
notes.htf_balance: Balance score blends overlap, repeated VWAP re-acceptance, and flip density from the ES 1-minute futures tape.
notes.orb_overlay: ORB overlays use the NQ daily regime rows matched to the current ORB trade stream, preferring Fred's inbound JSON when available, so you can see how chop affects breakout follow-through.
